Use this configuration activity to make the system settings that control the Count Stock app.

You can define basic settings for the Count Stock app that control the following behavior:
•Validity period of inventory counting documents retrieved from the backend system through the Past Days and Future Days settings. Documents with a planned count date outside the range defined by these settings are not provided to the Count Stock app. 
•Preloading of information about products to be counted to the app through the Preload Inv Products setting
You can preload information about products to be counted so that it is available when the app is started, or only load the information as associates select items to count. Preloading information provides associates with a faster response from the app as they will not have to wait for data from the back-end system. It also allows them to work offline when a connection to their network is temporarily unavailable. It is important to note that if the store has an exceptionally large volume of products assigned to the counting cycle, downloading, and storing all the data on the app might slow down the app's response time. The decision to preload data should consider the size of the data, the device hardware type, and the network connection.
•Preloading of inventory activity-related information to the app through the Preload Inv Details setting
You can preload details about the inventory activity, such as zones that have been counted and completed, when the app is started, or only load them as associates choose items to count by checking this setting or leaving it blank
•Automatically set the uncounted products quantity to zero through the Enable Zero Count setting
When a store associate finishes a counting task it is possible that some products are uncounted. As a manager, you want all the uncounted products quantities to be set automatically to zero upon submission to backend system.
