questions.configRef: Define List Variant and Assign Items
questions.topicDefinition:
You can maintain list variants.
List variants are used in sales price calculations to control how the list screen (pricing table) is displayed. On this list screen, the calculation is displayed and changes are made. The list variant determines which list fields appear on the list screen, and in which sequence.
questions.question:
Are there customer-specific business processes, that may need displaying  additional price elements in the sales price calculation run? for example, manufacturer's suggested retail price, maximum retail price.
You can create a custom condition type and link it using available list fields. Result  will show the pricing table including that list field.

questions.configRef: Maintain Relevance for Omnichannel Sales Promotions
questions.topicDefinition:
You can define combinations of sales organizations and sales order types that are relevant for omnichannel sales promotions.

If all relevant settings are made for omnichannel sales promotions, and a business user creates and saves a sales order for one of these sales organizations and sales order types, the system automatically adds the rewards (such as a discount or free goods) that are defined for the product to the item.
questions.question: Do you need to restrict the application of OPPS promotions to specific sales organizations and document types, rather than applying them across the entire company globally?

questions.topicDefinition: You can define your own purposes that a condition shall have in a business document. e.g. Discount, Fixed Price. You can later assign to a condition type.
questions.question: Do you need the flexibility to define custom purposes based on the promotions defined in the OPPS ?

questions.configRef: Assign Condition Purposes to Condition Types
questions.topicDefinition: You can assign condition purposes to condition types, before that you should have defined condition purpose. If you want the condition purpose to be valid for all pricing procedures, you can leave the Procedure field blank.
questions.question: Do you need the flexibility to define custom purposes based on the promotion defined in the OPPS and then assign those purposes to specific condition types within your business documents?

questions.configRef: Assign Discount Types to Condition Purposes
questions.topicDefinition: You can assign condition purpose to discount type that are provided by the SAP Omnichannel Promotion Pricing service. Before that you have defined Condition Purpose and assigned Condition Purpose to Condition Type.
questions.question: Do you need the flexibility to define custom purposes based on the promotions defined in the OPPS and then assign those purposes to specific price modfiers defined in the OPPS promotion rules?

questions.configRef: Define Fields Used for Generic Attributes
questions.topicDefinition: You can use sales order fields to determine calculation rule. Before that you should assign those fields to generic attributes defined in omnichannel promotion pricing service. For example, order reason, purchase order type
questions.question: Do you need the flexibility to define calculation rule in the OPPS based on S/4 sales order?

questions.configRef: Assign Generic Attributes to Distribution Chain
questions.topicDefinition: You can assign the generic attribute to a distribution chain.
questions.question: Do you need the flexibility to define different calculation rule per distribution chain?

questions.topic: BOM Explosion settings for Structured Articles
questions.topicDefinition: You control how structured materials are split into their components in logistics processes. For example, you want to explode the BOM for the sales set during POS inbound.
questions.question: Do you need the flexibility to manage inventory at component level or header level in purchase order or goods movements?

questions.topicDefinition:
Each business transaction entered into SAP S/4HANA Cloud is analyzed and split by the profit center or segment using document splitting. With this function, the document splits the line items based on the “characteristics” we define in the system.

To support the correct classification of each individual document during the splitting process, G/L accounts need to be classified into different categories – Revenue, Expense, Bank, Cash and Balance Sheet. 

SAP S/4HANA Cloud is delivered with an SAP Best Practices Chart of Accounts which have been categorized accordingly.
questions.question: Do you have additional G/L accounts which will be added to the SAP Best Practices chart? If so, please provide the list and categorize into Revenue, Expense, Bank, Cash, or Balance Sheet.

questions.configRef: Assign Accounting Principles to Ledgers and Company Codes
questions.topicDefinition: [object Object]
questions.question:
Do you have just need one ledger to cover your local accounting princple? 
Or you need to following both local and corporate accouting principle? If so, at the group level, should follow IFRS or US-GAAP?
Or, you need to follow both IFRS and US-GAAP at group level, and also need to fulfill local accounting principle?

questions.configRef: Define Profit Center Standard Hierarchy in Controlling Area
questions.topicDefinition:
Per the accounting principles IFRS and US GAAP, companies are required to report on their operating segments. In order to comply with this requirement, SAP offers the possibility to create segments. 
From an SAP point of view, segments represent divisions of the company for which financial statements and external reports can be created.
questions.question: Please define the hierarchy required to organize your profit centers to align with your organizational structure within the controlling area.

questions.topicDefinition: If you are using SEPA mandates to collect cash from customer accounts, SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with settings that enables the same. During the general business process of cash collection, you might be required to change the status of SEPA mandates created. However, you might want to restrict users from changing SEPA mandates to something that it should not be changed to. Here you define the statuses to which you cannot change a current mandate's status to.
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA Cloud has defined statuses that an existing mandate's status cannot be changed to. Review the list and indicate if any changes are required.

questions.configRef: Define Reason Codes for Status Changes
questions.topicDefinition: For all SEPA based AR receipts, SEPA mandates are created. You can define the reason codes for changing mandate status. The reason code explains why the status of a mandate has been changed. You can choose a reason code when you create or change a mandate.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Cloud system has a list of reason codes provided.

Please review and indicate if there is a need for additional reason codes, or for changes in descriptions of the existing reason codes.

questions.configRef: Set Up All Company Codes for Payment Transactions
questions.topicDefinition: You can set up all company codes against which there would be payables/receivables that have to be paid/received. You can make specifications for all company codes involved in the payment transactions.  You can also define permitted customer/vendor special GL transactions to be received/paid.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Cloud system comes with company codes set up for payment transactions.

Review settings delivered in the system and indicate if any new company codes added are to be set up or if changes to existing settings have to be made.

questions.topicDefinition: From an SAP point of view, the company code is an independent accounting unit for which a balanced set of books is produced. It represents the legal entity from fiscal point of view.
questions.question: Think of each country in the project scope and provide by country (where applicable) the number of legal entities required or are in scope.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud offers the ability to block business partners based on block reasons. There are a number of predefined block reasons delivered and assigned to pre-defined events. Typical examples include: bad scores, insolvency, high-risk country, or bad payment behavior.
questions.question: Please review the list of 10 block reasons provided with the Starter-System. If additional codes are required, please provide a list.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud offers the ability to consolidate the financial statements of the whole report in multiple group currencies so a group accountant can publish the results for stakeholders (e.g. analysts, investors) located in different regions or that are interesting in different reporting currencies.
questions.question: Do you have a requirement to consolidate your financial statements in multiple currencies? If so,  please review the test script for  Scope Item 4VB, Multi-Group Currencies for further guidance on the required configuration under "Define Versions".

questions.topicDefinition: As part of corporate close, you select and assign the defined monitor task groups, set up reclassification methods and tasks, and define selections that bundle filter criteria to be used in reclassification methods. In this step, you define reclassification tasks. Each reclassification task is assigned to a document type and reclassification method.
questions.question: The SAP S/4HANA Starter-System comes with reclassification tasks defined and assigned to document types and reclassification methods. Please review them and indicate if any specific changes are required.

questions.topicDefinition: In order to support closing and consolidation tasks, the SAP S/4HANA Cloud has task groups for data monitor and consolidation monitor defined. In this task, the task groups are assigned to versions and periods.
questions.question: The Starter System comes with task groups assigned to versions and periods. Indicate if task groups are required to be assigned to different versions and periods.

questions.topicDefinition: Define the numbering schemes that you want to use for classifying materials with commodity codes, intrastat service codes, and control classes.
questions.question: Your Starter-System is set up with a numbering scheme. Please review and indicate if additional numbering schemes are required.

questions.topicDefinition: Define the numbering schemes in which you want to enter commodity codes, intrastat service codes, and control classes. For the commodity codes, you can transfer the corresponding numbers from your SAP GTS System to the relevant numbering scheme. The data of this activity can also be changed directly in the Productive-System.
questions.question:
For the delivered numbering schemes, the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system is assigned with a numbering scheme content. 

If you have indicated to define additional numbering schemes, indicate their source here.

questions.topicDefinition: As part of setting up the SAP S/4HANA system for International Trade, you define the Numbering Scheme and Numbering Scheme Content. This activity ensures you activate the Numbering Scheme Content and you specify the time for which a numbering scheme is active. The data of this activity can also be changed directly in the productive system.
questions.question: The Starter-System comes set up with Numbering Scheme and Numbering Scheme Content which is activated for specific dates. Review the set up and indicate if any changes are required.

questions.configRef: Assign Numbering Scheme for Commodity Codes to Country
questions.topicDefinition: The Numbering Scheme settings on the SAP S/4HANA system are set up to perform International Trade. In this activity, the Numbering Scheme for commodities is assigned to countries.
questions.question: The SAP S/4HANA system comes with a Numbering Scheme for commodities assigned to countries. Review the set up and confirm if the Numbering Scheme is assigned to your country. Indicate if changes or additions are required.

questions.topicDefinition:
Once legal regulations are defined, you can define which license types you want to use within the legal regulations.

For all legal regulations, define license types. Available license types are: general license, collective license, individual license, and license exception.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Cloud Starter-System comes with license types defined for all legal regulations. 

Please review the settings for completeness. If additional legal regulations are required in for 'Define Legal Regulations', then indicate in your response the license types.

questions.topicDefinition: As part of setting up the SAP S/4HANA system for International Trade, you define the Sales Order Documents and Outbound Delivery Documents for which you would like to perform Trade Compliance Checks. In this step, you activate the sales order types for which you want to perform Trade Compliance checks.
questions.question: The Starter-System comes with a list of Sales Document Types. Indicate if you like any of the listed Sales Document Types is to be called for Trade Compliance Check.

questions.topicDefinition: As part of setting up the SAP S/4HANA system for International Trade, you define the Sales Order Documents and Outbound Delivery Documents for which you would like to perform Trade Compliance Checks. In this step, you activate the delivery types for which you want to perform Trade Compliance Checks.
questions.question: The Starter-System comes with a list of Outbound Delivery Documents. Indicate if you like any of the listed Delivery Document Types is to be called for Trade Compliance Check.

questions.topicDefinition: As part of setting up the SAP S/4HANA system to manage international trade, you can define compliance checks to be performed. In this activity, you can specify the company codes for which you want to perform the Trade Compliance Checks.
questions.question: The SAP S/4HANA system comes with company codes listed against which trade compliance checks have to be carried out. If there is a need to activate trade compliance checks against any company code, kindly provide a list of company codes that are required to have the setting.

questions.configRef: Switch Off Subsequent Functions in SD Processes
questions.topicDefinition: As you set up compliance checks to be performed on your international trade, you activate the company codes, sales order types, and document types against which compliance checks have to be carried out. In this section, you can specify the subsequent functions to be suppressed by a Trade Compliance block. Unless you make an entry here, all subsequent functions are allowed despite the block.
questions.question: The SAP S/4HANA system provides you to pick the subsequent functions sales processes to be blocked. Indicate if you would like to activate blocking of the subsequent SD processes.

questions.topicDefinition:
Certain international trades you perform might require compliance checks. Here, you define legal regulations for the individual Trade Compliance checks. The legal regulations are assigned to one “Trade Regulation Area“ at a time.

Once Trade Compliance checks are defined, you can activate sales order types/outbound delivery documents to perform these compliance checks and take necessary action such as blocking orders/deliveries.
questions.question:
SAP S/4HANA comes with legal regulations defined. Each legal regulation is classified as a Legal Control, Embargo, or Watch List Screening.

Review the settings in your Starter-System and indicate if there is a need for additional legal regulations.

questions.configRef: Configure Control Settings for Document Transfer
questions.topicDefinition: In SAP S/4HANA, you have the ability to transfer documents to SAP GTS systems. In this activity, you make the settings for transferring documents to the SAP GTS system.
questions.question: The SAP S/4HANA Starter-System has settings defined to transfer documents to SAP GTS system. Review the settings and indicate if any existing document types have to be added or removed.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA enables you to define authorization groups. These authorization groups enable you to protect the access of individual objects. To perform a particular activity, a user has to have the authorization for the activity and authorization group combination. You can use authorization groups to provide/restrict access to specific users.
questions.question: The Starter-System is delivered with the authorization groups defined. Please review and indicate if there is a need to have additional authorization groups for specific access control in your organization.

questions.configRef: Set Up Company Codes for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable
questions.topicDefinition: The SAP S/4HANA system allows you to define company codes that you want to use in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable. You will also have to assign the attributes required for controlling postings to each company code that you want to use in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable.
questions.question: Review the standard settings provided in your Starter-System and indicate if you require any change to be made. If you have added any additional company codes, indicate if you want to use them in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable.

questions.topicDefinition: You can define the company codes to be used for posting to contract account. These company codes are summarized in company code groups.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Cloud system comes with predefined company code groups.

If there are additional company codes defined, please review the standard settings and indicate if additional groups are required

questions.configRef: Assign Company Codes to Company Code Groups
questions.topicDefinition: In order to use the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system for Contract Accounts Receivables and Payables, set up Company Codes for Contract Accounts Receivables and Payables. You then define Company Code Groups. In this step, you assign the Company Codes defined for Contract Accounting to Company Code Groups.
questions.question: The Starter System is delivered with company codes set up for Contract Accounting. Review the Company Codes assigned to Company Code Groups and indicate if any changes are required.

questions.configRef: Configure Contract Acct Categories and Assign Number Ranges
questions.topicDefinition: In SAP S/4HANA for Contract Accounts Receivables and Payables, you define contract account categories as grouping characteristics for accounts that display the same control features.
questions.question: Review the settings in the Starter-System and indicate if there is a requirement to define contract account categories as grouping characteristics for accounts.

questions.configRef: Maintain Document Types and Assign Number Ranges
questions.topicDefinition: The SAP S/4HANA system provides you the ability to define document types that you want to use for the business transactions in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable. These document types help differentiate between business transactions; number ranges are also assigned to them, which determines the document number during document postings.
questions.question: The Starter-System comes with document types defined and number ranges assigned. Review the settings in your Starter-System and indicate if any changes are required.

questions.topicDefinition: While using Contract Accounting in SAP S/4HANA, you define the external main and sub transactions for your company. You then assign the parameters for document control, such as company code, and statistics key to these transactions. Main and sub-transactions control the determination of item attributes and processing of items.
questions.question: The SAP S/4HANA Starter-System comes with main and sub-transactions defined and assigned to document control parameters. Review the settings and indicate if any changes are required.

questions.topicDefinition: In SAP S/4HANA, you can define account assignments for cost accounting (such as cost center) in connection with the company code and the business area. You define the short key, which is then assigned to a cost object for a combination of Company Code, Business Area, Segment, Profit Center.
questions.question: The Starter-System comes with account assignments defined for the two company codes delivered with the system. Indicate if there is a need to have additional account assignments for the company codes. Indicate if you would like to have account assignments defined for any new company codes added.

questions.configRef: Define Specifications for Paying Company Code
questions.topicDefinition: You can make specifications for all company codes involved in the payment transactions. You can assign a paying company code to each company code. This means that you can have one company code process payment transactions centrally for several company codes. Specify the minimum amount for creating an incoming or outgoing payment.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Starter-System comes delivered with a list of paying company codes. 

Please review the system and indicate if any additional paying company codes are required. If there are new company codes defined, it will be required to analyze and arrive at a list of paying company codes.

questions.topicDefinition: There could be multiple reasons for a write-off. You have the option to define reasons for a write-off. Additionally, you can determine for each write-off reason, the reason code may only be used for a write-off of an individual item or for a mass write off or for both. You can also activate the reason code to be valid for partial write-off's.
questions.question:
Review the list of available write-off reasons in your Starter-System. 

Indicate if there needs to be a change in description to the write-off reasons or if any additional reasons are required.

questions.topic: Assignment of company code for invoice transfer
questions.topicDefinition: Here, you assign invoicing parties to the relevant company code(s) in order to transfer the supplier invoice data using a SOAP service.
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA allows you to enter company code names that your invoicing party uses. Review the standard available content and indicate if there is a requirement to enter company code names against individual invoicing parties.

questions.topicDefinition: Your suppliers invoices may include taxes, you can assign the tax rates mentioned on the invoices to tax codes. Here you assign the tax rates transmitted by your invoicing party (supplier) to the corresponding tax codes defined in the system.
questions.question: Review the Starter-System delivered list of tax codes. Indicate if there is a requirement to assign specific tax codes and rates to invoicing parties.

questions.topicDefinition: Costing sheets are used to define the parameters for overhead calculation and cost allocation. Cost centers are populated within the sheet to be credited in conjunction with the G/L account (cost element). It also requires the customer provide a list of overhead costs which are classified as fixed costs. SAP S/4HANA Cloud supports cost allocation by fixed percentage.
questions.question: Please provide a list of overhead cost centers/GL (cost element) combinations/percentage rates - to be credited at month end.

questions.topicDefinition: The collection strategy with its rules is used by the system to prioritize business partners when creating the collection worklists. You can define the currency in which the amounts are displayed in the worklist. You can also review how the respective rule contributes to the prioritization of the business partner in the worklist.
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered predefined with collection rules. Please review the collection rules on the Starter-System and determine if these are sufficient, require change or if additional ones are required.

questions.topicDefinition: The collection strategy with its rules is used by the system to prioritize business partners when creating the collection worklists. You can define the currency in which the amounts are displayed in the worklist. You can also review how the respective rule contributes to the prioritization of the business partner in the worklist.
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered predefined collection rules. The country currency is the default currency for determining the rules, however, if an alternative currency is required, please specify in your answer. Please note, that if you do specify the need for an alternative currency, this will become the default currency and is applied to all rules specified here.

questions.topicDefinition: Customers and vendors are created in SAP S/4HANA Cloud as business partners. These are grouped by categories on the system, however you are able to change the description of, delete or add additional groups to the ones provided (as shown on the Starter-System).
questions.question: Please review the settings on the Starter-System and provide the grouping criteria and descriptions required for your organization.

questions.topicDefinition:
In SAP S/4HANA Cloud, it is possible to setup and assign each company code to a default tax code. The code would default as a suggested code when entering a supplier invoice. 

Note: a tax code can be applied to a purchase order, which will automatically populate the invoice line when the invoice is posted. The default code suggested by the system can be changed by the user with the correct one, if needed.
questions.question: Review the default tax code found on the starter system. Please indicate if it is to be adjusted and what the change should be for your business.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud ships a default organizational structure which enables you to explore your solution covering company codes, plants, credit control areas, shipping points, etc.
questions.question: Please review default organizational structures found on the Starter-System and map them to your organization. In addition, provide a list of your mapped structures and naming requirements for each structure.

questions.topicDefinition:
Cost center category is an indicator in the cost center master data. It enables the assignment of same characteristics to similar cost centers. The cost center category controls the following functionalities:
- Record consumption quantities for postings
- Enter a default functional area
- Choose if primary costs or secondary costs are permitted and if commitments are allowed
questions.question: Review the existing cost center categories (as found on the Starter System) and the settings proposed. If needed, change the settings or add new cost center categories. Examples of existing cost center categories include: Marketing, Production, Logistics, Management, Sales, Administration, etc. Once reviewed, please provide a list of changes which are required.

questions.topicDefinition: Service cost levels determine the applicable cost rate for services provided by employees. They are attributes in the employee fact sheet. When an employee confirms working time to deliver a service, the system posts the service costs with a cost rate based on the employee’s service cost level. Services provided by that employee are, therefore, always charged at the same rate regardless of the service.
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered with a sample set of service levels. Please review them on the Starter-System and if required, provide a list of your service levels and descriptions.

questions.topicDefinition:
The costs occurred in the organization should be transparent. Therefore, SAP provides the functionality to analyze the overhead costs according to where they were incurred.

SAP S/4HANA Cloud provides a default set of cost centers per company code that can be used, changed, or deleted by the customer. New cost centers can be added as well, to better reflect the departments and organizational structure of the company. Please detail as is organizational structure/departments.
questions.question: Please provide details of cost center structures for each legal entity within the project scope.

questions.topicDefinition: To speed up the process of booking accounting documents and reducing errors, SAP offers the functionality to assign a default cost center for the cost accounts. This cost center will be determined automatically during the booking process.
questions.question: Determine and provide a list of cost accounts that require a default cost center. These would typically be for exchange rate gains/losses, revaluating material stocks, and inventory differences.

questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud will post automatically to G/L accounts for sales transactions, inventory movements, procurement activities, revenue, reconciliation, cash, and payment cards with the assignment of GL accounts (account determination).

It also supports the automatic posting of exchange rate differences and retained earnings and the reclassification of A/P and A/R accounts according to their maturity and assign G/L accounts to bank accounts.
questions.question:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered with a Best Practice Chart of Accounts YCOA (as found on the starter system).
Please review the account assignment provided for each of the area/parameter/subgroup categories.

questions.topicDefinition: Cost of Sales Accounting is supported in SAP S/4HANA Cloud by using the functional areas - characteristic that sorts operating expenses according to functions. SAP Best Practices provides functional areas for the following areas: Production, Marketing, Administration, Sales, etc.
questions.question: Determine if Cost of Sales Accounting will be used by your company, review, and update the existing functional areas (as found on the starter system) based on your company organization.

questions.topicDefinition: In accordance with special accounting principles, such as IAS/ IFRS, segment reporting is required for product related enterprise areas. The purpose of segment reporting is to make the profit and risk situation of individual areas (segments) in your enterprise transparent.
questions.question: If you are required to analyze and report profit by segments in your organization, please provide the list of sub areas (segments) within your organization which are required to be maintained for this purpose.

questions.topicDefinition:
Per the accounting principles IFRS and US GAAP, companies are required to report on their operating segments. In order to comply with this requirement, SAP offers the possibility to create segments. 
From an SAP point of view, profit centers represent divisions of the company for which financial statements and external reports can be created.
questions.question: Does your organization require the setup of segment divisional reporting?

questions.topicDefinition:
Per the accounting principles IFRS and US GAAP, companies are required to report on their operating segments. In order to comply with this requirement, SAP offers the possibility to create segments. 
From an SAP point of view, profit centers represent divisions of the company for which financial statements and external reports can be created.
questions.question: Please provide details of your divisional structures which would require financial and external reports within a company.

questions.topicDefinition:
During an intercompany sales process, the supplying company generates an intercompany invoice to the ordering company. You can generate the SAP Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) configuration that the system uses to post this invoice to the ordering company code.

The intercompany invoice is a customer invoice (sent from the supplying company). And a supplier invoice (received by the ordering company). The system uses IDocs to automatically generate the corresponding payables in the ordering company's accounts.
questions.question: Will you have intercompany transactions occurring between companies within the scope of SAP S/4HANA Cloud?

questions.topicDefinition: SAP provides each customer with an SAP Best Practice chart of accounts which covers all the reporting requirements for the business adopting SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
questions.question: Do you have a requirement to have your own custom chart of account?

questions.configRef: Define Tax Codes for Sales and Purchases
questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered with a set of tax (GST/VAT/Sales tax) codes for each country. These should not be deleted, however customers have an option to define additional tax codes if necessary.
questions.question: Please review the tax codes and rates that come delivered for each country in scope on the Starter-System. If additional codes are required, please provide a list of new tax description/rate assignment and define as input or output tax.

questions.configRef: Define Variants for Open Posting Periods
questions.topicDefinition: A posting period variant is created and assigned to each company code to support opening and closing periods. In SAP S/4HANA Cloud, there is a 1:1 relationship between company code and posting year variant as the posting period variant is created when the company code is created.
questions.question: Do you have a requirement to change the description of the posting period variants that were pre-delivered with S/4HANA Cloud?

questions.topic: Bank Communication Management Payment Release Strategy
questions.topicDefinition:
A payment release can be evaluated and reviewed by a default currency (i.e. all payments are evaluated in USD despite containing a mix of different currencies to make payment). It also provides the ability to evaluate payments from different company codes and local currencies.

Within the same step, also define and set the number of days for payment submission.
questions.question: What will be the default currency and set numbers of days for payment resubmission?

questions.topicDefinition:
A payment release can be evaluated and reviewed by a default currency (i.e. all payments evaluated in USD despite containing a mix of currencies). It also provides the ability to evaluate payments from different company codes and local currencies.

Within the same step, also define and set the number of days for payment submission.
questions.question: Please provide the number of days for payment resubmission for each legal entity.

questions.configRef: Make Global Settings for Electronic Bank Statement
questions.topicDefinition: Many companies receive their bank statement data from the bank electronically. With SAP S/4HANA Cloud, you can import the bank statement files into the SAP system using the electronic bank statement.
questions.question: Please provide details of banks within scope which will import bank statements into SAP S/4HANA Cloud. For the purpose of the questionnaire, only the bank name and file format sent from the bank.

questions.topic: Basic Settings for Minimum Cash Management
questions.topicDefinition: Cash management is used to monitor cashflows and ensure that you have sufficient liquidity to cover your financial obligations. It is integrated with other components of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. Where the full scope of cash management is activated, the customer is required to define how they wish to view new requests for payment signatories. Changes can be viewed by each individual request, company code, account type, or a combination of account type for each company code. Approvals can be activated immediately (directly), dual controls, or via a workflow.
questions.question: Please define how payment signatories are approved and method of approval using the topic definition as the guide.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud supports the reversal of previously posted documents but requires the use of reasons codes to not only define why the document was posted, but also control what is permitted during posting. These include determining if negative postings are allowed and whether the users can define alternative posting dates during the reversal process.
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered with four standard reason codes. Please review them on the Starter-System and determine if these are sufficient or if additional ones are required. If additional codes are required, please provide the reason description and settings required – for each (i.e. negative postings and alternative posting dates activation).

questions.configRef: Use Non-Leading Ledger for Offsetting Account Determination
questions.topicDefinition: Localization topic for China. In this configuration step, you define and activate a non-leading ledger for offsetting account determination and other related reports. You can only define and activate one non-leading ledger per company code for this purpose. Once you have created offsetting account postings in this non-leading ledger, the system automatically uses this ledger for offsetting account determination; you cannot change the ledger.
questions.question: Do you have a requirement to activate a non-leading ledger for offering account determination and other reports?

questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud supports GL accounts that are managed as "open items." These are typically balance sheet accounts to which there are corresponding debits and credits entries. Open item accounts are matched and cleared automatically by the system, however, it is possible that small differences may exist between the contra entries. The difference will be posted to a predefined P&L account.

SAP S/4HANA Cloud offers the possibility to setup tolerance groups for GL accounts. The groups define the tolerance thresholds for GL accounts assigned to the group. The groups are defined at company code level.
questions.question:
There are two pre-defined tolerance groups for GL accounts on the Starter-System for review.

Please review the existing settings and define the rules required, the maximum amount, or as a percentage that can be accepted as a difference during the clearing process. The difference will be posted to a predefined P&L account.

questions.topicDefinition:
Payment differences i.e. under/over payments are managed through the use of reason codes. Each reason code is clearly described and individually controls whether the difference is made to individual to either a separate under/over payment G/L account or to the origin of the transaction. 

Payment differences may arise from a number of circumstances – cash discounts, foreign exchange rate differences, quantity differences, etc. SAP S/4HANA provides an extensive list of reason codes to support the customer.
questions.question: Please review the list of reason codes and descriptions provided on the Starter-System.

questions.topicDefinition:
The incoming payment process from customers is supported in SAP S/4HANA Cloud automatically via the bank statement upload. In this process, it is possible that the actual amount paid by the customer does not match the value of the invoice. This can be triggered by fees charged by the bank, cash discount taken when net payment was due, and different currency exchange rates used or the customer made a calculation error.

To differentiate among these options, it is possible to create reason codes for each specific case. Using the reason code, it is possible to charge off the difference via a separate account or treated it as a dispute item with the customer.
questions.question: Review the reason codes provided on the Starter-System, if additional ones are required, please provide a list of specific business scenarios which have not be covered. Examples of reason codes provided include: cash discount, deducted bonus, invoice error, price query, bank charges, etc.

questions.topicDefinition: The payment terms represent the agreements you have with your business partners defining the terms of payment. When a purchasing or sales document is entered for a customer or vendor, the payment terms are copied from master data and are used to calculate the prices for the items, the due date of an invoice, or the total discount allowed. Examples of payment terms include 30 days net from invoice date, etc.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Cloud system comes with a list of standard values for the payment terms. Please review the Starter-System and if required, add/define your own rules with which the system can determine the required payment terms of payments automatically. 
You can use different payment terms of payment keys for suppliers and customers and  limit the permitted account type correspondingly within the terms of payment. 
Please define payment terms required for customers and suppliers.

questions.configRef: Average Cost of Reprocessing Bank Statement Items
questions.topicDefinition:
When the bank statements are loaded into SAP S/4HANA, incoming payments can be assigned to the open items in accounts receivables based on predefined rules. However, not all incoming payments will be assigned automatically and would require manual processing. 
This has a cost in terms of time used by the accounts receivable accountants. The setting of an average price for each unassigned open bank statement item lets you view the cost of the unassigned items over a period.
questions.question: Please provide an average cost for manually posting a bank line item to the general ledger.

questions.topic: Define Bank Account by payment type
questions.topicDefinition: In the automatic payment program, the determination of house bank accounts are dependent on the company, payment method, payment currency, and house bank.
questions.question: Please provide a breakdown of banks within the scope of the project (i.e. Bank A has three account(s) open- define the payment method/currency for each of the accounts in scope). A breakdown for each of your legal entities in scope is required.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud supports interest calculation on late or overdue payments that will post on the dunning letter. Please aware that this interest calculation does not generate an accounting entry.  Using the dunning process, it can be setup by dunning level and interest calculation per levels. Interest is generally calculated for higher dunning levels to render the dunning notice more insistent.
questions.question: If required, define the interest rate to apply for each dunning indicator that will show up on the dunning letter as interest.

questions.topicDefinition: Late or overdue customer payments can accrue interest. SAP S/4HANA Cloud supports this process using the dunning process. SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes delivered with one dunning procedure with four levels to defined charges or interest chargeable. However, you can create as many dunning procedures as you like.
questions.question: Please review the pre-delivered dunning procedure provided on the Starter-System and determine if you would need additional dunning procedures.

questions.topicDefinition: When outgoing payments are performed using the automatic payment program, the system determines the appropriate bank account to make the payment from. It uses a combination of the paying company code, payment method, and payment currency. Therefore, if a different bank accounts are used for checks vs. wire transfers, the payment program will determine the appropriate bank to use for this purpose. It is also able to determine which bank accounts can process foreign currency payments vs. domestic payments.
questions.question:
Please provide the ranking order of house banks to be used for payment based on the combination.

For example, Bank Account 100 ranked first for all domestic checks and wire payments, Bank Account 2 ranked first for foreign currency payments. If only one account is used for all payments - by default, it ranks first).

questions.topicDefinition: During the dunning process, SAP S/4HANA Cloud offers the possibility to block dunning for a specific document by entering a dunning block at the item level or block for dunning a specific customer (business partner). This functionality is realized through the dunning block reason. There are already predefined dunning block reasons as part of SAP S/4HANA SAP Best Practices (i.e. Disputed, Promised to Pay, Legal Department, etc.).
questions.question: Review the dunning block reasons provided on the Starter-System and define additional ones if needed. Dunning block reasons can be displayed in reports.

questions.topicDefinition:
As part of the SAP S/4HANA standard functionality, you can define tolerances to deal with situations in which the amount stated in the invoice differs from the amount received from the customer or paid to the supplier. A tolerance group is defined and can be assigned in the customer/supplier master data. For each tolerance group, you can specify the following:
1. Up to which difference in payment amount the posting to expense or revenue accounts is allowed by the system while clearing open items (amount and percentage)
2. Which terms of payment apply for residual (outstanding balance) items if they are posted during clearing.
questions.question: Review the tolerance groups provided on the Starter-System for customers and vendors and make the appropriate changes required by business or legal requirements.

questions.topicDefinition: You define the reference interest name, against which you will be able to assign interest rate values in a different step. You define list of all your reference interest rates such as LIBOR, etc. Define your reference interest rates by entering a key and a meaningful name.
questions.question:
The Starter-System comes with a list of reference rates defined. 

Please review the system for completeness or indicate if additional reference interest rates have to be defined.

questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud has the option to optimize outgoing payments, calculates, and triggers the maximum cash discount for each payment. 

The cash discount for outgoing payments is normally taken from the payment terms assigned in the invoice or the supplier master data.
questions.question:
Please define the additional setting requirements for each company code which are in scope.

Tolerance days for payables are the number of days by which the cash discount period may be exceeded.

questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud has the option to optimize outgoing payments, calculates, and triggers the maximum cash discount for each payment. 

The cash discount for outgoing payments is normally taken from the payment terms assigned in the invoice or the supplier master data.
questions.question:
Please define the additional setting requirements for each company code which is in scope.

Minimum percentage rates for payments with cash discounts (lower limit for payments with cash discount).

questions.configRef: Set Up All Company Codes for Payment Transactions
questions.topicDefinition: You can set up all company codes against which there would be payables/receivables that have to be paid/received. You can make specifications for all company codes involved in the payment transactions.  You can also define permitted customer/vendor special GL transactions to be received/paid.
questions.question:
The SAP S/4HANA Cloud system comes with company codes set up for payment transactions.

Review the Cash discount terms and tolerance levels defined for each company code on your starter system for completeness and identify what changes are required to meet your business needs.

questions.configRef: Set Up Paying Company Codes for Payment Transactions
questions.topicDefinition:
The process of vendor/customer payments in SAP S/4HANA Cloud is performed automatically once the system is setup. One requirement is to set up the legal entities that make payments and preset the permitted maximum and minimum payments values in the local currency.

If there is a requirement to make separate payments to a vendor, for example, one vendor has four invoices to be paid, you have the ability to create four separate payments/remittance advices. If this option is required, it will be activated for all payments made by the legal entity.
questions.question: Please provide a list of legal entities (company codes) which will be making payments listing the maximum and minimum amounts permitted. Also, indicate whether single payments are required by the company code.

questions.configRef: Set Up Paying Company Codes for Payment Transactions
questions.topicDefinition: The process of vendor/customer payments in SAP S/4HANA Cloud is performed automatically once the system is set up for you. If you have foreign currency payments occurring, the payment program posts the exchange rate differences arising from foreign currency items to an exchange rate gain and loss account (i.e. the difference between the rate at the time of posting and that when the item is paid). In order to determine the local currency amount at the time of payment, the payment program uses the exchange rates defined in the system. To avoid this occurring, you can deactivate the setting as part of the setting up of paying companies.
questions.question: Please Indicate against the list of legal entities (company codes) if exchange rate difference should be calculated or deactivated.

questions.configRef: Set Up Payment Methods per Company Code for Payment Transactions
questions.topicDefinition:
The process of vendor/customer payments in SAP S4HANA Cloud is performed automatically once the system is set up for you. It utilizes different payment methods (i.e. wire transfers, checks, direct debit, etc.) to determine how payables are made.

To make or enable automatic payments of customer credit balances or vendor payments, bank accounts from which the payments are made from are required.
questions.question: How many banks and bank accounts are required to support the project scope?

questions.topicDefinition: You can set block payments using payment block reasons within the automatic payment program, in addition to manual payments. If the indicator is set, the payment block reason prevents items with the clearing transactions "incoming payment" and "outgoing payment" from being processed. Blocks can be manually changed or resolved by resolution.
questions.question: Please check if there are block reasons and determine which block reasons should prevent automatic or manual payments. You can check the settings for the payment block reasons and make any corrections that may be necessary.

questions.configRef: Assign Flow Types to G/L Accounts
questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud enables customers to keep track of cashflows in, used within the business and outflows. Liquidity items are codes maintained to track cashflows within the business. Each item is marked as an inflow or liquidity items define are maintained as cash in or out flows (i.e. Cash receipt – In, Tax Refund – In, Bank Transfers – Out). 

You define and maintain flow types if a new G/L account is created and it requires a flow type to classify accounting document line items into different flow categories. Based on the setting, those items representing receivables, payable, or cash in transit can be properly integrated into financial operations cash forecasts.
questions.question: If you have defined additional General Ledger accounts to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud accounts within receivables/payables, cash in transit range, please indicate whether they should be considered for cash management.

questions.topicDefinition:
The incoming payment process makes use of intermediate accounts (clearing accounts) for each payment received (as recorded on the bank statement).

When the payment is cleared by the bank, as reflected on the incoming bank statement, all items are posted to the intermediate account which will clear when matched to open customer invoices. Balances left on the intermediate account reflect payments which have not been matched to customer accounts/line items.
questions.question: Check the GL account used for outgoing transfers provided in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud. There is only one set-up GL Account for this process, but you can maintain additional ones if needed. Please indicate if additional GL accounts are needed.

questions.topicDefinition:
During the outgoing payment process, SAP makes use of intermediate accounts (clearing accounts) for each payment based on the payment method used.

When the payment is cleared by the bank, as reflected on the incoming bank statement, outstanding items on the intermediate account will be cleared when matched. The balance would reflect payments done in SAP but not confirmed by the bank.
questions.question: Check the GL account used for incoming transfers provided in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud. There is only one set-up GL Account for this process, but you can maintain additional ones if needed. Please indicate if additional GL accounts are needed.

questions.topicDefinition:
During the outgoing payment process, SAP makes use of intermediate accounts (clearing accounts) for each payment based on the payment method used.

When the payment is cleared by the bank, as reflected on the incoming bank statement, outstanding items on the intermediate account will be cleared when matched. The balance would reflect payments done in SAP but not confirmed by the bank.
questions.question: Check the GL account used for outgoing transfers provided in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud. There is only one set-up GL Account for this process, but you can maintain additional ones if needed. Please indicate if additional GL accounts are needed.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud enables customers to keep track of cashflows in, used within the business and outflows. Liquidity items are codes maintained to track cashflows within the business. Each item is marked as an inflow or liquidity items define are maintained as cash in or out flows (i.e. Cash receipt – In, Tax Refund – In, Bank Transfers – Out).
questions.question: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with a list of liquidity items which should be reviewed on the Starter-System for completeness. If there any missing items or items which require renaming, please provide a list.

questions.configRef: Define Default Values for Transportation Data for Receipts
questions.topicDefinition: Intrastat is for collecting information and producing statistics on the trade in goods between the countries of the European Union. You can modify the default values for modes of transport at the border, ports, and airports. You can set default values for transportation data to be able to use these values when creating Intrastat declarations for receipts. Mode of Transport at the Border (Intrastat) Identifies the mode of transport (i.e. road, rail, or sea) by which the goods cross a border. This information is required for the Intrastat declaration.
questions.question: Provide the default mode of transport for receipts (i.e. road, rail, or sea) for each combination of 'Country of Destination' and 'Country of Departure.'

questions.configRef: Define Default Values for Transportation Data for Dispatches
questions.topicDefinition: Intrastat is for collecting information and producing statistics on the trade in goods between countries of the European Union. You can modify the default values for modes of transport at the border, ports, and airports. You can set default values for transportation data to be able to use these values when creating Intrastat declarations for dispatches.
questions.question: Provide the default mode of transport for dispatches (for example: road, rail, or sea) for each combination of 'Country of Departure' and 'Country of Destination.'

questions.configRef: Define Custom Variants for Correspondence Types
questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with pre-delivered standard correspondence types which, in addition, customers can create custom correspondence types by including additional parameters. Define custom variants for correspondence types by specifying additional parameters that are relevant for them. Correspondence type variants can be used to create custom correspondence in the SAP Fiori app.

To enable correspondence type variants in the SAP Fiori app, you need to specify UI labels for them using configuration step 2, 'Assign Labels and Company Codes to Correspondence Variants.' In addition, you can use this step to assign correspondence type variants to specific company codes.

To define which parameters should appear as mandatory, which should be 'read-only,' and should be hidden, use configuration step 3, 'Configure Parameters for Custom Variants.'
questions.question: This optional question is only relevant if you want to define custom correspondence types. Review the standard correspondence types on the Starter-System. List additional variants that you want to create.

questions.configRef: Assign Labels and Company Codes to Correspondence Variants
questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with pre-delivered standard correspondence types which, in addition, customers can create custom correspondence types by including additional parameters. Define custom variants for correspondence types by specifying additional parameters that are relevant for them. Correspondence type variants can be used to create custom correspondence in the SAP Fiori app.

To enable correspondence type variants in the SAP Fiori app, you need to specify UI labels for them using configuration step 2, 'Assign Labels and Company Codes to Correspondence Variants.' In addition, you can use this step to assign correspondence type variants to specific company codes.

To define which parameters should appear as mandatory, which should be 'read-only,' and should be hidden, use configuration step 3, 'Configure Parameters for Custom Variants.'
questions.question: This optional question is only relevant if you want to define custom correspondence types. Review standard correspondence types on the Starter-System. List additional labels and Company Codes that you want to assign to variants.

questions.topicDefinition:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud enables customers to create custom correspondence types by including additional parameters. Define custom variants for correspondence types by specifying additional parameters that are relevant for them. Correspondence type variants can be used to create custom correspondence in the SAP Fiori app.

To enable correspondence type variants in the SAP Fiori app, you need to specify UI labels for them using configuration step 2, 'Assign Labels and Company Codes to Correspondence Variants.' In addition, you can use this step to assign correspondence type variants to specific company codes.

To define which parameters should appear as mandatory, which should be read-only, and should be hidden, use configuration step 3, 'Configure Parameters for Custom Variants.'
questions.question: This optional question is only relevant if you want to define custom correspondence types. Review standard correspondence types on the Starter-System. List parameters that you want to assign to additional variants.

questions.configRef: Assign Sales Area to Credit Segment
questions.topicDefinition: SAP Credit Management helps you to make efficient credit decisions. Your system offers functions to determine the risk of lack of payment early on and helps the credit controller to make credit decisions quickly. To do this, you can make corresponding pre-settings or adjust reconfiguration.
questions.question: Please review standard settings for Credit Management on the Starter-System. If you decided to create more than one credit segment, please provide assignment of Sales Area to Credit Segment.

questions.topicDefinition:
SAP Credit Management comes with pre-delivered best practices 'Automatic Credit Control Checks.' You can decide to define your own credit checks.

The automatic credit check can target certain aspects during a check and run at different times during order processing. You can define your own credit checks to correspond to your requirements in the area of Credit Management.

You can determine an automatic credit check for any combination of the following:
   - Credit Segment
   - Risk Class
   - Credit Group

Example: you can define a credit check for a certain credit segment and for all sales orders in which the customer has risk class 2 (RK2).
It is possible to define a system response for each credit check (for example, warning message). In the case of a warning message, a block can be set in the credit status of a document.

If you define your own credit checks, proceed as follows: specify whether a credit check in SAP Credit Management is in scope
You can define check rules for the credit check in SAP Credit Management in the Define Checking Rules Customizing activity.
   - Specify system response to check
   - Allocate credit segment
   - Allocate risk class
   - Assign description to the credit check.
questions.question:
Answer only if you want to change automatic credit control. First review standard settings on the Starter-System. Please provide answers to the following:

1. Provide a combination of credit segment, risk class and credit group as well as a description for the credit check you want to define.

2. Provide details as found in corresponding SSCUI screen of credit control. Specify the scope of the check and the system response.

3. If necessary, provide the general data for the credit check.

questions.topicDefinition:
You can maintain the legal control settings for the individual legal regulations for Embargo.

You use this customizing activity to make settings for controlling the embargo check. You must define the business partners for which the system performs an embargo check. To do this, you must assign partner groupings to the legal regulations that you use for the embargo checks for import, and export transactions. Partner groupings can be created with SSCUIs in your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

Requirements: you have executed the Define Groupings of Partner Functions Customizing activity.
questions.question: First, review standard settings on the Starter-System. Please provide which legal regulations are assigned to which partner groupings for embargo check.

questions.topicDefinition:
You can define the legal regulation you want to activate for embargo. Set which legal regulations for embargo are to be checked for which country (country of the organizational unit responsible).

In this customizing activity, you can activate the legal regulations that you want to use for embargo based on the country of the responsible organizational unit (company code). The legal regulation determines which checks are performed with the trade compliance documents.
questions.question: First, review the standard settings on the Starter-System. Please provide answers to which legal regulations are to be checked for which organizational unit per country (company code).

questions.topicDefinition: You can create Partner Groupings to group your business partners. This can be used for example in Embargo Legal Regulations where you assign Embargo to Partner Grouping. Then, you assign Partner grouping to your Business Partner Master Data.
questions.question: First, review the standard settings on the Starter-System. Describe if you want to create additional partner grouping please.

questions.topicDefinition: Optionally, you can define a value adjustment key based on country or due date. You can then enter the value adjustment key in the customer master record. This value adjustment key determines the provision percentage rate used to calculate the value adjustment on customer open items.
questions.question:
First, review standard settings on the Starter-System. If needed, define a value adjustment key for the value adjustment. Provide the settings you need for individual value adjustment.

Later, you will be able to save the value adjustment key in the customer master record.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP Credit Management helps you to make efficient credit decisions. Your system offers functions to determine the risk of lack of payment early on and helps the credit controller to make credit decisions quickly. Customer credit groups are used to group business partners. The customer credit group is used as a selection criterion in reporting and when generating worklists. For example, possible customer credit groups are domestic and foreign customers, regular customers, or insured customers.
questions.question: Please review the default credit groups in your Starter-System. Provide information if you want to add or change default settings.

questions.topicDefinition:
Semantic tags and semantic tag groups can be assigned to your Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Structures (Financial Statement
Versions). For more information, see SAP Note 2538634. Pre-delivered semantic tags are used in reports or KPIs defined by SAP. These pre-delivered tags cannot be changed or deleted, otherwise the reports and KPIs would no longer work. Customers can make use of these pre-delivered tags in their own reports and KPIs. Semantic tag groups can be used to sort and organize semantic tags.
questions.question: Please check the Semantic Tag Groups in the Starter-System. Do you want to define your own Tag Groups?

questions.configRef: Define Semantic Tags for Balance Sheet-/Profit and Loss Structures
questions.topicDefinition:
Semantic tags and semantic tag groups can be assigned to your Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Structures (Financial Statement
Versions). For more information, see SAP Note 2538634. Pre-delivered semantic tags are used in reports or KPIs defined by SAP. These pre-delivered tags cannot be changed or deleted, otherwise the reports and KPIs would no longer work. Customers can make use of these pre-delivered tags in their own reports and KPIs. Semantic tag groups can be used to sort and organize semantic tags.
questions.question: Please check the default settings in the Starter-System. If you want to define your own tags, provide an ID, a name/long name, and assign the tag to a tag group.

questions.topicDefinition: The system uses categories to distinguish different sets of plan data. You can create different categories for different purposes. For example, for optimistic and pessimistic plan scenarios or for top-down and bottom-up planning or any other purpose.
questions.question: Review the standard settings in your Starter-System. Decide if you want to create Y categories for planning or edit existing categories. Please provide details if you decide to change standard settings.

questions.topicDefinition: In the General Ledger, you will find functionality for automatic clearing of GL open items. The program clears the open items that are grouped together if their total balance equals zero in local and foreign currency.
questions.question:
First, check the standard settings in your Starter-System. For each account type and account number interval, you can specify up to five criteria for grouping GL open items for automatic clearing.

Do you want to specify additional criteria for grouping GL open items for automatic clearing?

questions.configRef: Set Up Payment Methods per Country for Payment Transactions
questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with automatic payment functionality. Default settings are delivered which you should review in your Starter-System.
questions.question: Check in the Starter-System whether the payment methods required for your organization are defined in the system. Please communicate if you would like to make adjustments to the required payment methods by providing country-specific data.

questions.topicDefinition: There are global functions which concern various areas of the Group Reporting component. The settings you make here therefore apply throughout the entire system. Default settings are delivered which you should review in your Starter-System.
questions.question: Please check the default settings for Group Reporting and communicate any changes that you require. With default system provisioning, all functions are activated. SAP advises that you do not deactivate functions.

questions.topicDefinition: There is an option to define alternative reconciliation accounts allowed for each reconciliation account.
questions.question: Do you need any additional alternative reconciliation accounts?

questions.configRef: Assign Semantic Tags to Balance Sheet-/Profit and Loss Structures
questions.topicDefinition: Hierarchy nodes from financial statement versions are assigned to semantic tags. This enables the system to calculate values for the semantic tags.
questions.question: Please check the default settings. Would you like to change any semantic tag assignment?

questions.topicDefinition: Financial statement versions allow for definition of the balance sheet and profit and loss statement structure.
questions.question: Please review standard financial statement versions and decide if you wish to make any changes or create your own additional FS versions.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with standard chart of accounts. These accounts are used in all account determination for automatic posting. This is part of SAP Best Practices business processes.
questions.question: Please review standard accounts in the starter system to be able to participate in chart of accounts workshop and accelerate adoption of the solution.

questions.topicDefinition: SAP S/4HANA Cloud comes with standard chart of accounts. YCOA is the global standard chart of accounts.
questions.question: Please review standard chart of accounts as part of the preparation to participate in chart of accounts workshop.

questions.topicDefinition: Cost center categories help categorize cost centers according to the types of cost-related activities. You can define new categories yourself (such as P for a production cost center or A for an administration cost center), or you can use the cost center categories supplied by SAP. You can also define default values per cost center category.
questions.question: A number of cost center categories are included in the standard SAP system.

questions.topicDefinition: Exchange rates that apply for the same date for different purposes are defined in the system as exchange rate types. For example, you can define different exchange rate types so that you can use different exchange rates for your annual planning and your actual balance sheet month-end closing valuation.
questions.question: Please review standard exchange rate types. Do you want to propose any changes?

questions.configRef: Define Translation Ratios for Currency Translation
questions.topicDefinition: The translation ratios for currency translation need to be defined for each exchange rate type and currency pair. Usually ratio is 1:1 for example 1EUR:1GBP. The exchange rate from US dollar (USD) to Japanese yen (JPY) is maintained as follows:  1 USD per 100 JPY.
questions.question: Please check translation ratios delivered with the system. Do you wish to add any currency combination that is not included in the standard settings?

questions.configRef: Define Standard Quotation for Exchange Rates
questions.topicDefinition: If you need to perform currency conversions for a number of different currencies, you can simplify the management of exchange rates by entering a base currency for the exchange rate type. Instead of entering the exchange rates between each currency, you then only need to enter the exchange rate between each currency and the base currency. All currency conversions are then performed in two steps: into the base currency and from the base currency to the target currency.
questions.question: Do you want to use direct or indirect exchange rates?

questions.topicDefinition:
Currency translation rules are used to specify for financial statement (FS) how Currency translation differences and rounding differences are handled. Standard settings for the currency translation methods include the exchange rate indicator (ERI) and the currency translation key (CTK). These are assigned to the item sets for translation entries. The exchange rate indicator determines the exchange rate used in the currency translation. This can be either the monthly mean rate (MMR) or the monthly closing rate (MCR). The currency translation key controls whether cumulated values are translated at the rate of the current year (YTD) or periodic values are translated at the rates of their corresponding periods (PER). 
In the SAP standard delivery, multiple currency translation methods are predefined for consolidation chart of accounts Y1.
questions.question: Do you want to change standard translation methods?

questions.topicDefinition: You can use a fiscal year variant to define the number of posting periods in a fiscal year, how many special periods you need, and how the system should determine posting periods during posting.
questions.question: Check the standard fiscal year variants. Which fiscal year variant is suitable for your company?

questions.configRef: Create Ledger for Deviating Fiscal Year Variant
questions.topicDefinition: Fiscal year variants (FYV) define the relationship between the calendar and fiscal year. They specify the number of periods and the start and end date of a fiscal year. Globally acting companies, however, might need different fiscal year for group close and for local close.
questions.question: Do you need additional ledger with deviating fiscal year?

questions.topicDefinition: Check rules help to perform credit checks. There is a number of standard check rules delivered for immediate use. A check rule can consist of several individual check steps. In addition, you can define which parameters are relevant for each check step.
questions.question: Would you like to propose any changes to check rules?

questions.topicDefinition: You can use credit groups to combine different document types for your purpose of credit management. Once you've assigned document types to one credit group, they will be treated equally in the credit check.
questions.question: Do you need to create new credit groups?

questions.configRef: Determine Active Receivables Per Item Category
questions.topicDefinition: You can specify for each item category whether an item of the respective item category is to be included in credit management, such as credit check and update of open credit values.
questions.question: Do you want to change standard settings for item categories?

questions.configRef: Maintain Devaluation Percentages by Range of Coverage
questions.topicDefinition: Valuation according to the lower-of-cost-or-market principle is performed with valuation procedures. You write down inventory values in the balance sheet with devaluation percentages by range of coverage assigned to valuation procedures.
questions.question: Do you need valuation according to the lower-of-cost-or-market principle? If yes please propose percentage values.

questions.topicDefinition: You can assign cost objects (e.g. cost centers) to target GL accounts for automatic journal entry postings. This is relevant for postings where no CO account assignment object is entered for a cost-related posting, for example, MM or SD.
questions.question: Please prepare to define automatic additional account assignments for postings to primary cost elements.

questions.configRef: Assign Default Profit Center to Accounts
questions.topicDefinition: You can define a default profit center for each company code and account interval. This is only useful for P&L and balance sheet accounts in cases where the profit center cannot be derived or specified when the posting is made.
questions.question: Do you want to assign default profit centers?

questions.topicDefinition:
Depending on the FS items posted, different Sub assignments are necessary for the transaction data.
For example, payables and receivables items require partner unit sub assignments so that interunit payables and receivables can be eliminated. Some items require several sub assignments, for example partner unit and transaction currency.
In this step, you group sub assignments into breakdown categories, which you assign to FS items in their master data. Breakdown categories are defined for a particular chart of accounts.
questions.question: Do you want to change standard breakdown categories?

questions.topicDefinition: This configuration step provides you with pre-delivered payment medium formats. Payment medium formats allow you to communicate payment instructions to your banks, e.g. with a payment file.
questions.question: Please check if pre-delivered payment medium formats meet your requirements.

questions.topicDefinition: You can define the content of notes to payee. Fields in data media that include information on settled line items that is relevant for the business partner. This configuration step provides you with pre-defined notes to payee.
questions.question: Please check if standard settings suit your needs.

questions.topicDefinition: Definition of Credits is used in the Costing Sheet for Overhead Rates. Costing sheets allow you to assign overhead costs flexibly to products or product groups. Cost allocation is part of the process of determining overhead rates. If this leads to an object being debited with actual costs, another object in Cost Accounting (cost center) must be credited at the same time.
questions.question: Do you need to assign overhead rates? If yes please provide percentage rates.

questions.topicDefinition: Valuation variants enable you to define which prices are selected to value materials, internal activities, subcontracting, and external processing, and which costing sheets are used to calculate overhead.
questions.question: Which valuation variants will be suitable for your needs?

questions.topicDefinition: You can define for each plant, which prices are selected to value materials, internal activities, subcontracting, and external processing, and which costing sheets are used to calculate overhead.

questions.question: It is necessary to assign time and amount structure to various financial transactions for flows in your product type. Elaborate the steps and prerequisites for defining condition types for products types.

questions.topicDefinition:
Reason codes are used for the reasons for the handling of payment differences. Standard reason codes also allow management and auditors to analyze transaction history by specific reason.

Partial payments made for open items.
Residual items created for an open item. 
Differences posted on account without reference to an open item.

questions.configRef: Activate Additional Fields for Foreign Currency Valuation
questions.topicDefinition:
For multi-GAAP reporting and management reporting scenarios like valuations, we need to adjust ledgers with relevant settings. You can activate or deactivate additional account assignment fields that you want the system to include into the foreign currency valuation with this config.
The fields that you activate will be included in all advanced closing activities and will also be posted.

questions.configRef: Assign Financial Statement Versions to Accounting Principles
